This small plot of mine, only a quarter acre near the house, I use it for mixed crops to feed my family. I am an old woman now, 64 years, so I cannot work like before, but my children help me sometimes. I keep a few goats and chickens, so I have manure to put on the soil — chemical fertilizer is too costly for such a small piece, and the shop is far. I plant the seeds I saved from last season, like my mother taught me, and I weed by hand when the rains come.
